cause: Validation authority and economic reporting were initially distributed across caller-owned configuration, mutable row objects, and mutable collection structure instead of one canonical observed terminal receipt boundary.
prevention: Require successful observed terminal identity, canonical receipt digests, immutable provenance snapshots, exact ordered object membership, sealed report authority, and fail-closed reporting for every copied, mutated, duplicated, detached, reinitialized, or subclass-forged view.
summary: TASK-AR-652 independent reviews repeatedly found adjacent ways for request intent, receipt values, replaceable provenance, or mutable container membership to masquerade as observed savings evidence.
title: Bind economic eligibility to sealed observed receipts
